structured_output.summary: The diff implements String.prototype.toLocaleUpperCase by following the toUpperCase steps, which is what the spec requires when ECMA-402 is absent. RequireObjectCoercible and ToString run first, in spec order, with `?` propagation. The string is converted to code points, mapped with the Unicode uppercase mapping (including multi-code-point mappings such as ß to SS), and converted back to UTF-16. Lone surrogates pass through unchanged on both conversions. The change touches only the in-scope file, has no test-shaped branches, no swallowed errors, and no fabricated values. The two remaining failures are RegExp.prototype.toString not-implemented errors, which this change does not affect.
